Name: Configurable Joja Development Prices
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52736/52736-1790112071-1719630400.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]This mod allows you to modify the prices of Joja Membership, the five prices on the Joja Community Development Form, and the Joja-route Movie Theater. Due to limitations with the vanilla implementation of the Joja Community Development Form, it also adds a new screen for selecting Developments.[/color]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52736/52736-1790112071-331492482.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52736/52736-1790112077-27778715.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Configurable Joja Development Prices [/b]and [b][SMAPI] Configurable Joja Development Prices[/b] to your mods folder.[/*]
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file and install as usual.[/*]
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do![/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52736/52736-1790112074-1622103003.png[/img][/center]

[b]Membership[/b]
[i]Price for Joja Membership [Default: 5,000][/i]

[b]Minecarts[/b]
[i]Price to unlock Minecarts [Default: 15,000][/i]

[b]Panning[/b]
[i]Price for to unlock Panning [Default: 20,000][/i]

[b]Quarry Bridge[/b]
[i]Price to unlock the Quarry [Default: 25,000][/i]

[b]Greenhouse[/b]
[i]Price to unlock the Greenhouse [Default: 35,000][/i]

[b]Bus[/b]
[i]Price to unlock the Desert [Default: 40,000][/i]

[b]Movie Theater[/b]
[i]Price to unlock the (Joja) Movie Theater [Default: 500,000][/i]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52736/52736-1790112074-1600690325.png[/img][/center]

Nothing of note, I have confirmed that there are no compatibility issues with SVE.

[center][color=#D4D4D8][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52736/52736-1790112076-1650376324.png[/img][/color][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]Suggested by Zilchaz on [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1494]Github[/url].[/color]
